speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe when you first noticed the tremors and whether they affect your hands more when you're at rest or when you're using them? Also, have you experienced any changes in your walking pattern or balance recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: The tremor appears to be action-based given the difficulty with reading, but the resting vs. action distinction is crucial; could you clarify if the shake is present when his hands are relaxed in his lap? Additionally, have you noticed any stiffness, slowness of movement, or a "shuffling" gait when walking?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Resting tremor worse on the left hand. I also have Soft speech, Reduced facial expressions, Memory decline, Difficulty in managing finances.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease with early dementia.
